ticks.note: **t = 0, sleepT = 500**. (KIELER warns "Potential instantaneous loop through the timed transitions on t.", an advisory here.)
t = 500: Off → On, **on = true**, the reset makes **t = 0**; in the entry tick of On the clock does not advance: **sleepT = 200**.
t = 200: On → Off, **on = false, t = 0, sleepT = 500**.
t = 600 ≥ 500 (the clock overshoots by 100): **on = true**, and the reset makes **t = 0**.
